description: This file implements the VsockCameraDeviceSession class, which manages camera stream configuration, capture requests, and frame processing for a virtual socket camera device in an Android hardware camera HAL implementation. It includes methods for stream configuration, request handling, and communication with a frame provider.

classes.name: VsockCameraDeviceSession
classes.description: Implements the camera device session interface for a virtual socket camera, managing stream configuration, capture requests, and frame processing.
